details.title: Home Services Booking App for Customers
details.description:
Developed a user-friendly mobile application for customers to easily book various home services. The app streamlines the process of finding and hiring skilled professionals for tasks such as cleaning, plumbing, electrical work, and more.

Key features include service browsing with categories, real-time availability checking, instant booking, in-app messaging with service providers, secure payment processing, and a rating system for completed services.

details.title: Bank Currency Price Scraper
details.description:
Developed a web scraping application to collect and analyze currency exchange rates from multiple banks. The project automates the process of gathering up-to-date currency prices, providing valuable insights for financial analysis and decision-making.

The application uses advanced web scraping techniques to extract data from various bank websites, processes the information, and presents it in a user-friendly format for easy comparison and analysis.

details.title: Luxury Yacht Rental Marketplace for Saudi Arabia
details.description:
Developed a comprehensive yacht rental platform tailored for the Saudi Arabian market. The application serves two distinct user types: customers looking to rent yachts and yacht providers offering their vessels.

Key features include an intuitive booking system, detailed yacht listings with high-quality images, real-time availability calendar, secure payment processing, and a review system. The platform also incorporates Arabic language support and adheres to local regulations and customs.

details.title: Cargo Shipping Booking App for Customers
details.description:
Developed a user-friendly mobile application for Eramex, allowing customers to easily book vehicles for shipping their cargo. The app simplifies the process of arranging shipments and tracking deliveries.

Key features include vehicle selection based on cargo size, real-time pricing, booking management, shipment tracking, in-app messaging with drivers, digital documentation, and delivery confirmation.

details.title: Comprehensive Mental Health Tracking and Analysis App
details.description:
Developed an innovative mental health application that combines mood tracking, stress analysis, and Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) techniques. The app utilizes machine learning algorithms to provide personalized insights and recommendations.

Key features include daily mood logging, stress level assessment, CBT exercises, and data visualization for tracking progress over time. The app aims to empower users with tools for better mental health management and self-awareness.

details.title: Maritime Vessel Booking and Management Dashboard
details.description:
Created Bahar, a sophisticated web application for managing bookings and operations of various maritime vessels. This platform caters to boat rental companies, yacht charters, and commercial shipping operations.

Key features include vessel availability tracking, automated scheduling, maintenance logs, crew management, and detailed voyage planning tools. Bahar aims to modernize maritime operations by providing a user-friendly, comprehensive solution for vessel booking and management.

details.title: Sports Facility Booking and Management Platform
details.description:
Developed Marafiq, a comprehensive web application for renting and managing sports courts and grounds. The platform streamlines the booking process for various sports facilities, enhancing accessibility for users and efficiency for facility owners.

Key features include real-time availability checking, secure online payments, user reviews, and an intuitive dashboard for facility managers. Marafiq aims to promote sports participation by making it easier for people to find and book suitable venues for their activities.

details.title: Home Services Management App for Service Providers
details.description:
Created a comprehensive mobile application for home service providers to manage their business and connect with customers. This app empowers professionals to offer their services, manage bookings, and grow their client base efficiently.

Key features include profile creation and service listing, real-time job notifications, schedule management, in-app communication with customers, navigation to job locations, digital invoicing, and earnings tracking.

details.title: Cargo Shipping Management App for Providers
details.description:
Created a comprehensive mobile application for Eramex shipping providers to manage their fleet and handle customer shipments efficiently. This app empowers drivers and fleet managers to streamline their operations and provide excellent service.

Key features include real-time order notifications, route optimization, cargo space management, digital manifests and waybills, in-app navigation, proof of delivery capture, and earnings tracking.

details.title: Home Services Booking Management Dashboard
details.description:
Developed HomeServe, a comprehensive web-based dashboard for managing bookings of various home services. This platform enables service providers to efficiently handle customer requests, schedule appointments, and manage their workforce.

Key features include real-time booking updates, service provider assignment, customer communication tools, and analytics for business insights. HomeServe aims to streamline the home service industry by providing a centralized system for managing diverse service offerings.

allExperience.companyDescription: Leading DevOps initiatives at Eram Group, focusing on cloud infrastructure automation and deployment optimization. I automate AWS infrastructure using Terraform, containerize applications with Docker, and manage deployments via Kubernetes. My role involves building CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions to improve delivery speed, setting up monitoring and alerting with CloudWatch for system reliability, and enabling high availability and scalability with Auto Scaling and fault-tolerant architectures.

Developed comprehensive backend services and integrated cutting-edge AI services & LLMs at Eram Group. I supervised junior developers and collaborated closely with product owners on requirements and SRS documentation. A key achievement was building an AI-powered dashboard that pulls directly from databases to generate real-time insights, significantly enhancing data-driven decision making across the organization.

Specialized in AI model optimization at Outlier, focusing on fine-tuning Large Language Models (LLMs) to enhance response accuracy by 35%. I created sophisticated feedback loops for continuous model optimization, contributing to significant improvements in AI system performance and reliability. This role provided deep expertise in machine learning model training and optimization techniques.

Gained foundational software development experience at Algoriza, learning Agile methodologies and Test-Driven Development (TDD) practices while successfully delivering 5 key features. I developed proficiency in Git workflow management and code refactoring techniques, establishing strong software engineering fundamentals that became the foundation for my professional career in backend development and DevOps.
